commentary_segments.text: The most common technique to reduce the distortion is by application of feedback. Feedback reduces distortion in two ways. First of all, it reduces the relative current swing. Secondly, it reduces the distortion by the feedback factor (or loop gain). Let us investigate how the coefficients of the power series are affected by the feedback. We will now calculate the actual distortion components IM and IM . Index f is used to indicate that they are valid for a system with 2f 3f feedback.
